panels.title: Stock Intel: Entry Signals
panels.body:
Re-runs the analyst entry pass a few times a day so entry-watch signals stay current between daily briefs. Framework, not advice; nothing here places orders.

**Runs** 10:00, 12:00, 14:00 and 15:45 on weekdays, and only when the market is actually open.
**Calls** the app at intel.config.app_base_url with header auth. The app does the work; this workflow is the clock.

zones.title: Trigger + market-open gate
zones.body: Cron fires four times a weekday. Alpaca /v2/clock is the source of truth for the session, so holidays and early closes skip themselves: when is_open is false the gate emits nothing and the run ends quietly.

zones.title: Run the entry pass
zones.body: App URL reads intel.config.app_base_url, so the callback host is configuration rather than a hardcoded name. POST /api/entries/signal then re-scores every live entry-watch ticker against today's prices and queues an analyst pass for the ones that moved into or out of their zone. Summary normalises the answer: 202 with queued analysis ids, 429 when the analyst daily cap is spent, 404 when nothing is on watch. Never fails the run.
